reason: Dark Ocean's acceptance experiment did not pass on 2026-08-22, and what ran on afterwards was narrower than the project: a nightly notary asking the Copernicus catalogue whether it still says what it said. Over 54 nights it rechecked 62,737 catalogue rows; 32 products diverged — 14 left the catalogue, 18 only changed their modification date. The maintainer judged that this does not hold the practice's attention, and attention is the one thing this practice cannot spend twice.
kept: Nothing is deleted. Every reading, continuity probe, snapshot and anchor stays here and verifiable; the record ends on its last night.
